description: Accuracy of the parabolic log-magnitude peak picker on one noisy sine.

issue_figures.bound_why: the issue's 0.73 mHz takes A^2 / sigma^2, twice the SNR of the recipe; the bound with A^2 / (2 sigma^2) is 1.04 mHz

name: 48-peak-accuracy

recipe.draw_order: uniform(seed, 2 * trials) gives offset then phase per trial; the noise of trial i is gaussian(seed + 1 + i, frame_len)
recipe.frequency_hz: 100 Hz plus a uniform offset of up to half a bin of 8192, one draw per trial
recipe.phase: uniform in [0, 2 pi), one draw per trial

rounding: the issue prints mHz to two decimals and bins to three
